sports.h3: Alcaraz crushes Wu to reach US Open second week, Paul next
sports.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beat Wu Yibing 6-3 6-4 6-1 on Friday to extend his Grand Slam winning run to 17 matches, while Daniil Medvedev also moved into the fourth round.
body: Defending champion Carlos Alcaraz beat Wu Yibing 6-3 6-4 6-1 on Arthur Ashe Stadium on Friday 4 September, his first match back after nearly five months out with a wrist injury. He broke serve immediately, was pegged back in the first two sets, then dropped just one more game in the third.

The win stretched his unbeaten run at the majors to 17 matches, dating back to last year's US Open and this year's Australian Open title. He next faces American 20th seed Tommy Paul, who beat Alexander Bublik in five sets, while seventh seed Daniil Medvedev beat Arthur Rinderknech 6-4 6-4 6-4 to reach the last 16.

sports.h3: Sabalenka halts match over cannabis smell, Pegula rallies past Fernandez
sports.summary: World number one Aryna Sabalenka stopped play over a strong smell of cannabis, then beat Kamilla Rakhimova 6-3 6-4, while Jessica Pegula rallied past Leylah Fernandez.
body: World number one Aryna Sabalenka halted play on Louis Armstrong Stadium over a strong smell of cannabis. She then beat Kamilla Rakhimova 6-3 6-4 without facing a break point, hitting 29 winners and 10 aces.

Third seed Jessica Pegula lost the first set 1-6 to Leylah Fernandez before rallying to win 6-4 6-3, and next faces Sorana Cirstea, 36, who beat Jasmine Paolini 6-3 6-3. Ukraine's Marta Kostyuk also advanced, beating Ekaterina Alexandrova 6-3 6-2.

sports.h3: Van de Zandschulp stuns De Minaur in straight sets in New York
sports.summary: Botic van de Zandschulp beat Alex de Minaur 6-4 7-5 6-2 on Thursday, his first win over the Australian in five meetings, reaching the third round.
body: Botic van de Zandschulp beat Alex de Minaur 6-4 7-5 6-2 late Thursday, his first win over the Australian in five meetings, winning 77 percent of first-serve points to reach the third round. De Minaur, who had beaten him earlier this year in Rotterdam, served seven double faults in the loss.

It capped a week that also saw third seed Felix Auger-Aliassime and Lorenzo Musetti exit early. Van de Zandschulp, best known for upsetting Alcaraz at the 2024 US Open, next meets Belgium's Zizou Bergs for a second-week spot.

sports.h3: Monfils takes final Grand Slam bow after loss to Learner Tien
sports.summary: Gael Monfils, 40, ended a 22-year Grand Slam career on Thursday night with a 6-3 6-4 6-3 second-round defeat to 20-year-old American Learner Tien.
body: Gael Monfils, 40, ended his 22-year Grand Slam career with a 6-3 6-4 6-3 second-round loss to 20-year-old American Learner Tien, seeded 14th. Tien, who also beat Monfils in Montreal last month, asked the Frenchman for his autograph afterward as the Louis Armstrong Stadium crowd chanted his name.

Monfils, who is retiring at the end of the 2026 season, had earlier become the oldest man to win a US Open main-draw match since Jimmy Connors in 1992. He plans to stay involved in tennis after retiring.

sports.h3: Russell leads Mercedes one-three in Monza practice as Leclerc splits them
sports.summary: George Russell topped Friday's second practice for the Italian Grand Prix, 0.120s clear of Charles Leclerc, with Antonelli third and Verstappen only ninth.
body: George Russell set the fastest time in Friday's second practice for the Italian Grand Prix at Monza, 0.120s clear of Ferrari's Charles Leclerc, with team-mate Kimi Antonelli third. Max Verstappen was only ninth for Red Bull, over eight tenths off the pace.

Lando Norris was fourth ahead of Lewis Hamilton, Oscar Piastri, Arvid Lindblad and Ollie Bearman, with Yuki Tsunoda tenth filling in for Liam Lawson. Final practice and qualifying are Saturday, ahead of Sunday's race, round 13 of the season.

sports.h3: Antonelli to start home race from the back and tow Russell in qualifying
sports.summary: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli will take an engine penalty at Monza and is expected to give team-mate George Russell a slipstream in qualifying.
body: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli will start Sunday's Italian Grand Prix from the back of the grid after Mercedes fitted a new power unit. He has now used his fourth of four permitted engines this season following reliability problems including a Barcelona failure.

Team boss Toto Wolff picked Monza for its four overtaking zones, which give a fast car a good chance to recover places. With his own grid slot irrelevant, Antonelli is expected to tow team-mate George Russell in qualifying, worth several tenths on the straights.

sports.h3: Babadi scores seconds into debut as Sparta and PEC share four goals
sports.summary: PSV loanee Isaac Babadi scored with his first touch after coming on in the 68th minute, but Koen Kostons headed PEC Zwolle level for a 2-2 draw at Het Kasteel.
body: PSV loanee Isaac Babadi scored roughly ten seconds after coming on in the 68th minute, but Koen Kostons headed a late equaliser for PEC Zwolle in a 2-2 draw at Het Kasteel on Friday. Sparta twice led in the Eredivisie's fifth-round opener before Kostons rescued a point for Henry van der Vegt's side.

Babadi, 21, joined Sparta on loan from PSV in the final hours of the transfer window. Sparta are still waiting for a convincing start to the season, with attention now turning to Saturday's Topper between Ajax and champions PSV at the Johan Cruijff ArenA.

sports.h3: Ajax close window with 11 signings as PSV and Feyenoord bring back old faces
sports.summary: Deadline day saw Ajax add Simon Adingra and Thilo Kehrer, PSV re-sign Sam Lammers and Feyenoord bring Reiss Nelson back on a free.
body: Ajax closed the transfer window with 11 new signings, including Simon Adingra on loan and Thilo Kehrer, plus Julian Brandt, Marc-Andre ter Stegen, Sofyan Amrabat, Daley Blind and Viktor Tsygankov. Marcos Leonardo was the record buy at just under 20 million euros and Caio Henrique cost 10 million from Monaco.

PSV re-signed Sam Lammers from FC Twente and added Mikkel Bro Hansen and Nyoni Santos. Feyenoord brought back Reiss Nelson on a free and signed Nacho Ferri for nine million, while Willem II loaned Manchester United's Chido Obi.

sports.h3: Xavi picks first Oranje shortlist as Van Dijk and De Jong questions linger
sports.summary: New coach Xavi Hernandez must name a squad by 6 September before facing Germany in the Nations League on 24 September, with Van Dijk and De Jong's futures unresolved.
body: New Netherlands coach Xavi Hernandez must submit a preliminary squad on 6 September before the final list on 18 September. Nations League games follow against Germany on 24 September and Serbia three days later, in a group completed by Greece.

Virgil van Dijk, 35, is still deciding whether to continue and wants clarity on his role, with 100 caps within reach if he stays. Frenkie de Jong remains at odds with Barcelona over treatment for his World Cup knee injury, with the club pushing surgery against his preference for conservative recovery.

sports.h3: SailGP makes Valencia debut with fight for third place wide open
sports.summary: The inaugural Spain Sail Grand Prix runs 5-6 September off Valencia, with 13 F50 crews racing and six points separating fourth to seventh in the standings.
body: The inaugural Spain Sail Grand Prix runs on 5 and 6 September off Valencia, moving after four years in Cadiz, with 13 F50 crews racing and around 10,000 spectators expected. Saturday's fleet races feed into Sunday's final.

Home team Los Gallos, led by Olympic champions Diego Botin and Florian Trittel, race in front of their own crowd. The tightest battle is for third overall, where Emirates GBR, the USA, France and NorthStar are split by six points.

sports.h3: ADCC Worlds one week out as Krakow prepares for first Polish edition
sports.summary: The 2026 ADCC World Championship runs 12-13 September in Krakow, with Kaynan Duarte facing Yuri Simoes in the superfight and only four 2024 champions defending.
body: The 2026 ADCC World Championship runs 12-13 September at Tauron Arena in Krakow, the first time Poland has hosted the event and grappling's first European return in almost a decade. Kaynan Duarte faces Yuri Simoes in the superfight, with only four 2024 champions defending.

Five men's divisions of 16 and three women's divisions of eight include UFC fighter Mateusz Gamrot for the home crowd. The IBJJF World Master Championship runs through 5 September in Las Vegas, and judo's IJF tour resumes in Budapest from 11-13 September.

sports.h3: Van Aert finally lands Vuelta stage win as Mas keeps red jersey
sports.summary: Wout van Aert outsprinted Valentin Paret-Peintre in Loja on Friday to win stage 13 of the Vuelta a Espana, his fourth attempt from the breakaway this race.
body: Wout van Aert outsprinted Valentin Paret-Peintre in Loja to win stage 13 of the Vuelta a Espana, attacking from a breakaway with 3.6km left on the 193km stage from Almunecar. It was his career win number 58, with team-mate Matthew Brennan third ahead of 20-year-old Jarno Widar.

Enric Mas finished safely in the peloton to retain the overall lead, with the top eight on GC unchanged. Mattias Skjelmose gained 2:10 from the break to stay seventh, while Gregor Muhlberger crashed out of ninth place early in the stage.

consumer-tech.h3: IFA 2026 opens: Xiaomi takes Samsung's old spot, AMD shows 192GB AI laptop chip
consumer-tech.summary: The 102nd IFA opened 4 September with 1,900 exhibitors, Samsung absent from the main halls for the first time in 35 years and Xiaomi taking the largest stand.
body: The 102nd IFA opened on 4 September with 1,900 exhibitors from 49 countries, Samsung absent from the main halls for the first time in 35 years and Xiaomi taking the largest stand. Samsung instead showed a 1,100Hz Odyssey G6 monitor at a private Berlin venue.

Xiaomi filled Hall 6.2 with over 380 products including the European debut of its SU7 electric sedans and the Xiaomi 18 Fold on its 3nm XRing O3 chip, pledging 7.4 billion euros in AI research through 2028. AMD opened the keynotes with the Ryzen AI Max Pro 400 series, supporting up to 192GB of unified memory to run 300-billion-parameter models locally.

consumer-tech.h3: Apple sets 9 September event for iPhone 18 Pro and first foldable iPhone
consumer-tech.summary: Apple will unveil the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max and its first foldable iPhone at Apple Park on 9 September at 10:00 Pacific, with no standard iPhone 18 until spring 2027.
body: Apple will unveil the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max and its first foldable iPhone at Apple Park on 9 September at 10:00 Pacific, with no standard iPhone 18 until spring 2027. The foldable, tipped as iPhone Ultra, opens from about 5.5 to 7.6 inches and uses Touch ID instead of Face ID.

Apple is also expected to show the Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, a new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini, and set release dates for iOS 27, iPadOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate. Reports point to price rises due to memory shortages, in the first major launch under chief executive John Ternus.

consumer-tech.h3: Galaxy S26 FE goes on sale at 699 dollars, 50 dollars more than last year
consumer-tech.summary: Samsung's new Fan Edition phone went on sale 4 September with an Exynos 2500 chip, Android 17 and seven years of updates, priced from 699 dollars for 128GB.
body: Samsung's Galaxy S26 FE went on sale on 4 September at 699 dollars for 128GB, 50 dollars more than last year, with an Exynos 2500 chip, Android 17 and seven years of updates. It has a 6.7-inch 120Hz AMOLED display at up to 1,900 nits and a 4,900mAh battery.

Cameras are a 50MP main sensor with OIS, a 12MP ultrawide and an 8MP telephoto, all capable of 4K at 60fps, with the 256GB version at 799 dollars. Samsung ships almost the full Galaxy AI suite, including Now Brief and Interpreter, though the price rise narrows the gap to the standard S26.

consumer-tech.h3: TCL shows paper-like AMOLED phones and Dolby Vision AR glasses at IFA
consumer-tech.summary: TCL used Berlin to launch the P80 series, the first phones with NXTPAPER AMOLED screens, alongside RayNeo smart glasses and a 10,000-nit flagship TV.
body: TCL launched the P80 series in Berlin, the first phones with NXTPAPER AMOLED screens combining OLED contrast with anti-glare, low-blue-light treatment, alongside a four-model TAB A1 tablet range. Its RayNeo GT Max became the first AR glasses certified for Dolby Vision.

TCL's TV line-up is topped by the X11L SQD-Mini LED with 20,736 dimming zones and up to 10,000 nits peak brightness, alongside the Bang and Olufsen-equipped C8L. Rival Hisense confirmed a renewed UEFA partnership for EURO 2028 and showed RGB MiniLED sets at the show.

consumer-tech.h3: Robot cleaners, a camera toothbrush and Roku's first OLED TVs land this week
consumer-tech.summary: Ecovacs and Dreame unveiled flagship cleaning robots at IFA, Dyson revealed a 500 dollar toothbrush with a built-in camera and Roku announced OLED TVs from 999 dollars.
body: Ecovacs unveiled the Deebot X12S OmniCyclone, a 1,199 pound robot vacuum with 27,000Pa suction and a bagless auto-empty station. Dreame countered with the 1,299 pound Aqua20 Pro Ultra Roller X, using a steam source and extending roller mop.

Dyson's CameraJet, its first electric toothbrush, combines an AI camera with a water flosser for 500 dollars. Roku entered the OLED TV market with a Pro Series OLED at 999 dollars for 55 inches, with 120Hz panels and Dolby Vision.

consumer-tech.h3: Tesla lets FSD grab the wheel during manual driving as Cybercab rides begin
consumer-tech.summary: Tesla's FSD Supervised v14.3.9 can activate on its own to steer around an imminent collision, a day after Tesla launched its Cybercab robotaxi in Austin.
body: Tesla's FSD Supervised v14.3.9, announced Friday 4 September, adds a safety layer that can steer the car itself during manual driving to avoid an imminent collision. It can also intervene if the driver seems heavily distracted or has switched FSD off by accident.

Critics warn a false positive that steers could be riskier than one that only brakes, citing v14's history of unexpected swerves. The update follows Thursday's Cybercab launch in Austin, a two-seat robotaxi with no steering wheel, and Tesla shares rose about six percent to 378.75 dollars.

consumer-tech.h3: RivianOS 2 puts every Rivian on one software stack with Unreal Engine 5
consumer-tech.summary: Rivian began pushing update 2026.31 to R1 and R2 vehicles on 4 September, its biggest in-car software overhaul yet.
body: Rivian began pushing update 2026.31, its biggest software overhaul yet, to R1 and R2 vehicles on 4 September. It rebuilds the interface, adds real-time police and speed-camera alerts through Google Maps, and introduces an AI layer called Unified Intelligence.

The R2 and second-generation R1 render 3D visualisations in Unreal Engine 5, while first-generation R1s stay on Unreal Engine 4. A rebuilt Settings 2 menu adds universal search, and the 14.99 dollar a month Connect+ tier adds a weather app and new privacy toggles.

consumer-tech.h3: EVs lift UK car market to best August in years as VW plans 100,000 job cuts
consumer-tech.summary: UK registrations rose 13.7 percent to 94,236 in August with battery EVs taking a 29.8 percent share, as Volkswagen agreed a second 50,000 round of job losses.
body: UK car registrations rose 13.7 percent to 94,236 in August, the ninth straight month of growth, with battery EVs taking a 29.8 percent share. Electric cars have taken a record 25.6 percent of sales this year, short of the 33 percent mandate target.

In Germany, Volkswagen agreed with unions on Thursday to cut a further 50,000 jobs by the end of the decade, taking total planned reductions to 100,000. A separate AVILOO study of 500,000 battery health tests found none of 20 EV models lost more than 10 percent median capacity within 50,000km.

consumer-tech.h3: Uber launches London's first robotaxis with 15 Wayve cars and safety drivers
consumer-tech.summary: Londoners can now hail a self-driving Uber, though each of the 15 licensed vehicles keeps a human behind the wheel ready to take over.
body: Uber launched London's first self-driving taxis on 3 September, with 15 licensed vehicles using Wayve's software, though each keeps a human safety driver ready to take over. Uber said over 100,000 London customers had told it through the app they would choose a driverless option if available.

A BBC journalist who took one of the first rides described a mostly smooth trip with a single intervention by the safety driver. The GMB union has called for the rollout to include protections for professional drivers as the fleet grows.

consumer-tech.h3: Xbox to cap cloud gaming at 15 hours a month from November
consumer-tech.summary: Game Pass Ultimate subscribers will be limited to 15 hours of cloud streaming per month, after which they must buy additional play time.
body: Microsoft will cap Xbox Game Pass Ultimate cloud streaming at 15 hours a month from November, after which subscribers must buy additional play time. The company said the change is driven by the rising cost of running cloud gaming and will let it keep investing in the service's reliability.

The cap applies to the 16.99 pound a month Ultimate tier, the main way to stream Xbox titles to phones, browsers and TVs without a console. It marks a retreat from the unlimited streaming that has been part of the Game Pass pitch since xCloud launched.

consumer-tech.h3: Hackers dump data of 8.7 million airport customers on the open web
consumer-tech.summary: Personal data stolen from Manchester Airports Group, operator of Manchester, Stansted and East Midlands, was published in full after the company refused to pay a ransom.
body: Personal data stolen from Manchester Airports Group, operator of Manchester, Stansted and East Midlands airports, was published on the open web after the company refused to pay a ransom. The roughly half-terabyte database includes emails, phone numbers, addresses and travel histories, affecting 8.7 million customers.

The attackers posted the entire set on the regular internet rather than a dark web leak site, making it easier to access. MAG says no bank details were held, and experts warn victims to expect phishing given the included future travel plans.

consumer-tech.h3: Nvidia to buy Hugging Face for 12.9 billion dollars
consumer-tech.summary: Nvidia announced Thursday it will acquire the open-model hub for 12.93 billion dollars, betting that open AI model support can offset any slowdown in chip demand.
body: Nvidia announced on Thursday it will acquire Hugging Face for 12.93 billion dollars, one of its largest deals ever. Hugging Face, founded in New York in 2016, hosts the world's largest library of open AI models and counts Intel, AMD and Amazon among its backers.

The deal gives Nvidia direct ownership of the platform most developers use to download and fine-tune open models. In a busy week for AI releases, Google shipped Gemini 3.8 Flash after missing its promised June date for Gemini 3.5 Pro.

consumer-tech.h3: iOS 27 adds iPhone Handoff for switching between two phones on one number
consumer-tech.summary: Apple has surfaced a feature in the iOS 27 beta that lets users move between two iPhones sharing the same phone number, days before the software's release date is set.
body: Apple has surfaced an iPhone Handoff feature in the iOS 27 beta that lets users move between two iPhones sharing the same phone number. The capability was listed without explanation on a WWDC slide in June and has now appeared in the latest developer build.

It would allow someone to keep a foldable and a standard iPhone active on one number and hand calls between them, fitting next week's expected iPhone Ultra launch. Apple is expected to announce public release dates for iOS 27, iPadOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate at its 9 September event.
